    Gradings by a group #

    A G-grading of a k-vector space V with finite support is a family of projections proj g (orthogonal, summing to the identity over a finite set supp). GrAlg G k A grades a k-algebra multiplicatively; GrMod grades an A-module compatibly (A_g · M_h ⊆ M_{gh}).

    A k-linear map is homogeneous of degree h when it maps V_g into W_{gh}. Every A-linear map between graded modules is the finite sum of its homogeneous components (sum_comp), and the components are A-linear (comp).

    A finite grading of a k-vector space.

    • supp : Finset G
    • orth (g h : G) : g ≠ h → ∀ (v : V), (self.proj g) ((self.proj h) v) = 0

    • sum_eq (v : V) : ∑ g ∈ self.supp, (self.proj g) v = v
